map.汽车电池在线测试工具，输入冷启动电流（CCA）与内阻评估电池健康状态，给出状态判: An online car battery test tool: enter cold cranking amps (CCA) and internal resistance to assess battery health and return a verdict, for battery selection and replacement. Fully client-side.
map.高于参考值 30% 需关注: Over 30% above the reference value needs attention
map.12.6 V 以上满电；12.2 V 约 50%: Above 12.6 V is full; about 50% at 12.2 V
map.铅酸电池内阻随温度降低而升高，低温下内阻可增加三成以上，这是冬季冷启动困难的主因: Lead-acid internal resistance rises as temperature falls, growing by over 30% in the cold, one main reason for hard winter starting. Applying roughly 1.2%/°C, this tool converts the measured resistance to the 25 °C standard condition before comparing with the reference, so a cold reading is not misjudged as "high resistance".
map.普通万用表无法准确测量电瓶内阻（毫欧级），需用电导式电池测试仪或在带载条件下测压: An ordinary multimeter cannot measure battery resistance accurately (milliohm level); use a conductance battery tester or measure voltage drop under load. Treat the measured CCA as the equivalent cold-cranking current derived from resistance; algorithms differ slightly between brands, so use one device for like-for-like comparison.
map.💡 启停电池（EFB/AGM）的参考内阻天然低于普通铅酸，本工具已按类型给出系数: 💡 Start-stop batteries (EFB/AGM) naturally have lower reference resistance and this tool applies a correction factor by type; always replace with the same type, or start-stop function and charging strategy fall out of step.
map.📚 深度解析：电池 CCA 与内阻健康度检测: 📚 In-depth: Battery CCA and Internal Resistance Health Testing
map.冷启动无力、多次打火才着车时，测 CCA 与内阻判断电池是否已老化到需更换。: When cranking is weak and the engine needs several attempts, measure CCA and internal resistance to judge whether the battery has aged enough to replace.
map.保养或长途出行前做例行检测，在电池彻底失效前提前更换，避免半路抛锚。: Run a routine test before servicing or a long trip so the battery is replaced before it fails, avoiding a breakdown en route.
map.更换电池时按车辆排量核算所需 CCA，避免选型偏小导致寒区冷启动困难。: When replacing, size the required CCA against engine displacement so an undersized choice does not make cold-region starts difficult.
map.标称 CCA 600 A、实测 510 A 的普通铅酸电池，健康度 SOH =: A conventional lead-acid battery rated 600 A that measures 510 A has SOH = 510 ÷ 600 ≈ 85%; internal resistance measured at 25 °C is 7.2 mΩ against a reference of 3500 ÷ 600 ≈ 5.83 mΩ, about 23% high, giving "degraded, needs attention" - not yet at the replacement line but already declining. If the same 7.2 mΩ is measured at 10 °C, converting to 25 °C gives 7.2 ÷ [1 + 0.012 × 15] ≈ 6.1 mΩ and the deviation falls to about 5%, showing that cold readings must be converted before comparison or resistance looks out of spec.
map.万用表能测电池内阻吗？: Can a multimeter measure battery resistance?
map.不能准确测量。电瓶内阻是毫欧级，普通万用表在如此小的电阻下，表笔接触电阻与引线电: Not accurately. Battery resistance is in milliohms, and at such small values probe contact and lead resistance are of the same order as the reading, so error dwarfs the result. Use a conductance battery tester, or measure voltage drop under load and derive it, and stick to one device for comparison.
map.AGM / EFB 启停电池能换普通铅酸吗？: Can an AGM / EFB start-stop battery be replaced with a conventional flooded one?
map.不建议。启停电池的充放电策略与普通铅酸不同，AGM/EFB 的内阻更低、深放电耐: Not advisable. Start-stop batteries handle charge and discharge differently: AGM/EFB have lower internal resistance and tolerate deep discharge better. Fitting a conventional unit upsets the start-stop function, mismatches the charging strategy and shortens life greatly. Always fit the same type and specification, and some models also need battery registration with a scan tool.
map.冬天启动困难一定是电池的问题吗？: Is a hard winter start always the battery's fault?
map.不一定。低温下电池内阻升高、可用容量下降（-18 ℃ 时约为常温的六成），确实更: Not necessarily. Cold raises battery resistance and cuts usable capacity (about 60% of normal at −18 °C), making cranking weaker; but starter wear, poor ground connections, thick oil and the state of plugs and injectors cause hard starting too. Measure open-circuit voltage and CCA first, then starter current and circuit voltage drop, rather than just swapping the battery and still having the problem.
map.内阻须用电导式电池测试仪测量（万用表无法测毫欧级），CCA 为仪器按内阻反推的等: Resistance must be measured with a conductance tester (a multimeter cannot read milliohms); CCA is the equivalent figure derived from resistance, so compare using the same device
